name: Two names: two pointed tags
when: Two characters are named one after the other (about 1 to 2 s apart) while both are on screen side by side. Each name sits on a pointed plate, set on one line low in the frame (y 830-936) with its point right under its person.
anchor: The scene starts on the first name (at1 = 0): tag 1 ticks on frame 3 and types out by frame 11. Tag 2 does the same from at2, the second name's word.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.name1: the first name as the voice says it (shown in capitals), 20 characters at most
vars.name2: the second name as the voice says it (shown in capitals), 20 characters at most
vars.at1: seconds after the start: when the first name is said (normally 0, the scene starts on it)
vars.at2: seconds after the start: when the second name is said
vars.head1X: person 1: x in px of the middle of their head or chin on the 1920x1080 frame (the tag's point goes under it). Read it off a snapshot; 60 px off still reads right
vars.head2X: person 2: x of the middle of their head or chin
vars.out: seconds after the start: when both tags start to leave together (the scene ends 0.23 s later); at least 1.4 s after at2

changed: nametag-A3's pointed plate once per person with the point on the top edge, both on one line low in the frame. Each runs outward from its point; two that would touch are pushed apart (32 px gap). No face box, no y value needed.
